text:
alejandra: new starter quickstart: after SSO invite + ToS I hit 'Run' and the app shows 'Request failed (403)' with zero context.

alejandra: browser console shows `{"error":"workspace_billing_required","msg":"billing not attached"}` but UI is opaque.

support-bot: Hi @alejandra — your workspace needs a billing method before hosted endpoints are enabled. Add one here: https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/xy9/billing :credit_card:

ty: thanks for reporting. short-term workaround: use a service key locally (export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_...) and the sample app will work.

ty: longer term we should: (1) map that backend code -> friendly banner with console link, (2) add an onboarding note about SSO invites created before billing is attached.

alejandra: I'll file a docs PR if you point me at the recommended copy. Also curious if we can emit a clearer header so clients don't have to parse JSON.

ty: yes — plan is `x-redwood-why: billing_required` on 403. I'll open INF ticket and a tiny starter-repo PR to show the banner.

alejandra: great, thanks. leaving this here until PR merges.
